summary: Iteration 3 re-verification of two HIGH bugs from iteration_2 plus light regression on v2 features. BOTH BUGS NOW FIXED. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (was 13/14) — checkout/status now returns 200 even after immediate creation (try/except around stripe.get_checkout_status falls back to cached txn). Frontend: /app/onboarding with demo session cookie now correctly transitions to results phase on mount (useEffect gated on `user` from AuthContext). Verified: results-panel rendered, all 10 target-promote-{0..9} buttons present, clicked target-promote-1 (TalentFlow Systems) → POST /api/targets/{id}/promote returned 200, button text changed from 'PROMOTE TO PIPELINE' to 'VIEW IN PIPELINE', and the promoted deal appears in the Prospecting column on /app/pipeline (14 total cards). Regression: dashboard charts render (recharts containers detected), unauth user redirected from /app/dashboard to /login with [data-testid=google-signin-btn] visible.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warning a few times during initial layout — not breaking (130 recharts elements render correctly after settle), but ResponsiveContainer may briefly mount before its parent has dimensions. Consider giving the chart wrapper an explicit min-height or aspect ratio to silence the warning.

action_items: None blocking. Both HIGH bugs are verified fixed. Optional: tidy Recharts ResponsiveContainer warnings on /app/dashboard by giving the chart wrapper a min-height.

Carry-over (non-blocking from iteration_2): consider splitting server.py (now 793 lines) into routers; migrate @app.on_event to lifespan handler; normalize payment_status values to Stripe-canonical ('unpaid'/'paid'/'no_payment_required') instead of 'initiated'.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in /api/payments/checkout/status (server.py L653-664) is correct: wraps stripe.get_checkout_status in try/except Exception and returns the cached txn row with amount_total computed as int(amount*100). Safe fallback shape matches the success branch.

Fix in Onboarding.jsx useEffect (L57-86) is correct: effect now guards on `if (!user) return` and depends on [user], so the auto-load fires only after AuthContext resolves /auth/me. The cancelled flag also prevents stale state writes if user changes mid-flight.
Carry-over: server.py is now 793 lines — still recommend splitting into routers (auth/payments/dashboard/leads/pipeline/onboarding/targets) per code-review guidelines.
Carry-over: @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
Carry-over: payment_transactions.payment_status diverges from Stripe-canonical values (uses 'initiated' instead of 'unpaid'). Consider normalizing for consistency with Stripe webhooks.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 flows: onboarding-results, promote, pipeline visibility, dashboard charts, unauth login redirect)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All v2 features verified working: auth gating, charts, target promotion (full E2E from onboarding results → POST /promote → pipeline visibility), Stripe checkout creation + graceful status polling, DnD pipeline (verified iter_2), Landing routing for unauth, /login google-signin-btn. Pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_v2.py is idempotent and safe to rerun. The previously-blocked target-promote E2E flow is now fully testable via the demo cookie.
rca of the issue: Both fixes confirmed via direct reproduction: (1) BUG 1 — wrapping stripe.get_checkout_status in try/except Exception in /api/payments/checkout/status/{session_id} (server.py L653) now returns 200 with the cached payment_transactions row when Stripe raises (e.g. 'No such checkout.session' immediately after create). Verified by test_checkout_status_open which posts a checkout session and immediately polls status — now consistently 200. (2) BUG 2 — adding `if (!user) return` guard and `[user]` dependency to Onboarding.jsx useEffect (L57-86) eliminates the AuthContext-induced remount race. The effect now fires only after /auth/me resolves and `user` is non-null, so setPhase('results') is not interrupted by a ProtectedRoute re-mount. Verified by navigating to /app/onboarding with demo cookie set → results-panel + 10 target-promote buttons render within 3s.
